learning_outcomes.text: Clarify the nature of symmetrical and asymmetrical short circuit processes, the changes in fault currents over time, and the influence of different factors on these processes.
Acquire practical methods for calculating fault currents in low and high voltage electrical networks.
Consider methods and means for short-circuit current limitation.

syllabus_topics: Practical methods for calculation of three-phase short circuits
teaching_methods: Lectures (hard copy and web-based training tool, multimedia projectors, interactive whiteboards)
Seminar classes (personal computers and software for fault current calculations)
assessment_rules: Assessment is based on continuous assessment and a written exam. Two tests are held during the semester.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Electrical Power Engineering (Bachelor)
